Make the capstone gate-block fall through to the non-capstone task slate so every milestone produces SOME forward artifacts even when the headline aggregation is blocked.

meta_reflection: The honest operational signal is binary: zero experiments executed, so there is no execution-efficiency story to tell this milestone — only a production gap. The highest-leverage fix is not GPU or throughput tuning (both GPUs were correctly idle with no compute-bound task) but a fast-fail circuit-breaker so a stalled, gate-blocked milestone is caught in minutes instead of consuming the full window. Per the .333 wipeout precedent, a single zero-artifact milestone usually traces to a backend outage or a capstone gate that will not fall through, and both are detectable at activation.
